plan: Given my private value of $21, I should bid slightly above the maximum possible value other bidders might have, which is $20. This ensures I win if others bid their maximum possible value. A bid of $20.1 should suffice, allowing me to win against any bid at or below $20, maximizing my profit if their bids are below my value.

My private value for the item is $27. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a win while minimizing payment. A reasonable bid is slightly above the midpoint of the maximum value ($20) and my private value ($27), around $23. This ensures a higher chance of winning while keeping potential costs lower than my value.
